tools.name: search
tools.description: Search HaulierScope for operators (company name, licence number or company number) and guides. Returns ids to pass to fetch. Prefer search_operators for structured operator results.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text (Markdown) of a result from search: an id like 'licence:OB1234567', 'company:02155951' or 'guide:vet-a-haulier', or a HaulierScope page URL. The text carries the DVSA file date, sources and the canonical URL.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_operators, fetch · Private data: search_operators, get_licence, recent_changes, tc_decisions, biggest_operators, data_status, fetch · Public sink: biggest_operators.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_operators, fetch · Private data: search_operators, get_licence, recent_changes, tc_decisions, biggest_operators, data_status, fetch · Public sink: biggest_operators

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
